# Iconography

<!-- Generated using generate-iconography-documentation.swift -->
<!-- DO NOT EDIT - This file is automatically generated -->

The Spark iconography available in the **Iconography** asset catalog.

## Overview

The icons are split in 2 sets:
- **Criteria**: exposed on ``ImageResource/SparkCriteria`` and usable with `Image(sparkCriteria:)` and `UIImage(sparkCriteria:)`.
- **Global**: exposed on ``ImageResource/Spark`` and usable with `Image(spark:)` and `UIImage(spark:)`.
